#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# applications/CMakeLists.txt - OpenFOAM executables (auto-generated)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set(FOAM_APP_LIST "")

function(foam_app dir)
    cmake_parse_arguments(A "OPTIONAL" "ENABLE_VAR" "" ${ARGN})
    if(NOT A_ENABLE_VAR)
        string(REPLACE "/" "_" oname "${dir}")
        set(optname "FOAM_APP_${oname}")
    else()
        set(optname "FOAM_APP_${A_ENABLE_VAR}")
    endif()
    option(${optname} "Build ${dir}" OFF)
    if(NOT ${optname})
        message(STATUS "  [off] ${dir}")
        return()
    endif()
    foam_add_executable("${FOAM_APP_SRC_DIR}/${dir}")
    list(APPEND FOAM_APP_LIST "${dir}")
    set(FOAM_APP_LIST "${FOAM_APP_LIST}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application-local libraries (built unconditionally: they are cheap and
# several apps link them, eg -lrhoCentralFoam from rhoCentralFoam/BCs)
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function(foam_app_lib dir)
    foam_add_library("${FOAM_APP_SRC_DIR}/${dir}")
endfunction()
